exposure: Endoscopic treatment with pneumatic balloon dilation and stent insertion
Complications (two sites of stenosis and twisting, severe adhesions, acute pancreatitis) following laparoscopic re-sleeve gastrectomy
outcome: Effectiveness and safety of endoscopic treatment
cohort: A single patient experiencing two sites of stenosis and twisting due to severe adhesions and acute pancreatitis following a laparoscopic re-sleeve gastrectomy.
finding: Endoscopic treatment with pneumatic balloon dilation and stent insertion proved effective and safe as the first-line management for a patient with two sites of stenosis and twisting due to severe adhesions and acute pancreatitis post-laparoscopic re-sleeve gastrectomy.
